SASBDB entry SASDWR5  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDWR5/)

Publication: A protein-dependent riboswitch activates ribosomal frameshifting in cardioviruses
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.molcel.2026.07.036

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDWR5/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
